authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13544.1 sūkara gives Pali sūkara, Prakrit sūara, Bengali suor and Bhojpuri sūwar pig. Selected Bengali śukor/ʃukor preserve the velar (possible learned/contact influence), Bishnupriya huor has regional sibilant weakening to h, and Tharu suɹa/suwər/sura match the contracted branch. These are qualified family links, without a claim to a settled immediate Indo-Aryan donor or identical transmission history. Exact response: śukor.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9237.1 biḍāla gives Nepali birālo, Bengali birāl/bilāl/bilāi, Oriya bilāi and western Pahari bəraḷe in the addendum. Selected biralo/berale/biɽal and bilei/bilui/bileⁱ/bileya fit the rhotic and reduced bilāi branches; source vowel differences and final glide are retained. Local Indo-Aryan transmission is unresolved. Exact response: biɽal.
